version_notes: v1.0.0 (2026-10-18) adds interview-prep as the 8th job-hunter family member (idea borrowed from the ai-job-search /interview command, built on our own anti-fabrication rules). load_application.py reads one tracked application (tracker.json entry, the submitted resume and cover letter, posting text, confirmed LESSONS.md entries) without writing the tracker. build_prep_pack.py builds a stage-specific pack (6 stages) mapping posting requirements to the user's real lines, with STAR scaffolds, honest gap bridges, questions to ask, and source-checked research (posting URLs rejected, interviewer research kept professional). Every answer line is a blockquote; the claims subcommand extracts them for the bundled verify_no_fabrication gate (byte-identical to resume-tailor). Optional mock-interview mode. Never auto-sends or contacts anyone.
